title: PACIFIER: Pacing Opinion Depolarization via a Unified Graph Learning Framework
abstract: arXiv:2602.23390v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Online social networks often form opposing echo chambers that reinforce opinion polarization. Under the Friedkin-Johnsen (FJ) model, ModerateInternal (MI) and ModerateExpressed (ME) reduce polarization by neutralizing selected users' internal or expressed opinions, but existing solutions are largely model-specific and learning-based depolarization remains underexplored. We study FJ-based moderation as feedback-free autoregressive sequential planning and propose PACIFIER, a unified graph-learning framework that constructs ordered intervention sequences from the initial graph-opinion instance without using recomputed post-intervention expressed opinions as intermediate feedback. PACIFIER combines history-aware node representations with Greedy and RL variants for immediate and long-horizon action scoring, and supports MI, ME, continuous opinions, cost-aware moderation, and node removal. We evaluate intervention trajectories by Acc

translated_title: PACIFIER：通过统一图学习框架缓解观点极化
translated_abstract: 在线社交网络常常形成对立的回声室，加剧观点极化。在弗里德金-约翰森（FJ）模型下，中度内部（MI）和中度表达（ME）通过中和选定用户的内部或表达观点来减少极化，但现有解决方案大多特定于模型，且基于学习的去极化研究仍不充分。我们将基于FJ的调节视为无反馈的自回归序列规划，并提出PACIFIER，一个统一的图学习框架，它从初始图-观点实例构建有序干预序列，无需使用重新计算后的干预后表达观点作为中间反馈。PACIFIER结合了历史感知节点表示与贪婪和强化学习变体，用于即时和长期行动评分，并支持MI、ME、连续观点、成本感知调节和节点移除。我们通过准确性评估干预轨迹。
tldr: 本文提出PACIFIER，一个统一的图学习框架，通过无反馈自回归序列规划有效缓解在线社交网络中的观点极化，支持多种调节模式并优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PACIFIER, a unified graph learning framework that mitigates opinion polarization in online social networks via feedback-free autoregressive sequential planning, supporting multiple moderation modes and outperforming existing approaches.
